findings.defect: A fight to the death does not convey that both opponents die.
findings.rationale: 동귀어진 means mutual destruction, which is what So Gyo recognizes in his threat.
findings.replacement: “So you’re ready to take me down with you. Heh.”

findings.current: “Yeah. Why insist on fighting me with that battered body of yours, even if it means a fight to the death?”
findings.defect: The question again reduces his willingness to die alongside her to an ordinary lethal fight.
findings.rationale: So Gyo specifically asks why he would face her despite his condition and his willingness to accept mutual destruction.
findings.replacement: “Yeah. Why insist on fighting me with that body of yours in such poor shape, when you’re even prepared to die taking me down?”
findings.source: “그래. 동귀어진마저 각오하는, 그 성치 않은 몸으로 굳이 내게 맞서려는 이유.”

findings.current: “And I think I understand a little why Prince Shangshan, that child, follows you around so much. Yes. I really do.”
findings.defect: “Follows you around” makes the prince’s devotion sound like physical trailing.
findings.rationale: Here 따르다 describes the child’s regard for Taekyung, not where he walks.
findings.replacement: “And I think I understand a little why Prince Shangshan, that child, looks up to you so much. Yes. I really do.”
findings.source: “그리고 상산왕, 그 어린아이가 왜 그리 널 따르는지 조금은 알 것 같네. 응, 확실히.”

findings.current: So if one life of mine could make up for it, I’d be lucky.
findings.defect: “Make up for it” suggests his death would compensate for those already killed, rather than stop further harm at the cost of his life.
findings.rationale: His stated reason for fighting is that fewer of his people will die; 퉁칠 수 있다면 frames his own life as the cost of that outcome.
findings.replacement: So if I could put an end to it with just my life, I’d count myself lucky.
findings.source: 그러니 나 한 사람으로 퉁칠 수 있다면 오히려 다행이다.

findings.current: Not because I needed time to think. To me, the reason was so obvious that I didn’t know what to say.
findings.defect: The draft adds an inability to find words that the source does not state.
findings.rationale: The source explains his silence solely by how self-evident the reason is to him.
findings.replacement: Not because I needed time to think about the reason, but because it was so obvious to me.
findings.source: 그 이유에 대해 고민할 시간이 필요해서가 아니라, 나로서는 너무나도 당연한 일이었기 때문에.

findings.current: Her toes touched the bud of some nameless flower in full bloom, soaking up the strongest sunlight of the year.
findings.defect: “Bud … in full bloom” is contradictory in English and obscures the delicate landing.
findings.rationale: The flower is described as fully blooming under the sunlight; the English should not make its point of contact an unopened bud.
findings.replacement: Her toes touched the blossom of a nameless flower, opened wide beneath the year’s strongest sunlight.
findings.source: 일 년 중 가장 강렬한 햇빛을 받아 활짝 만개한, 어느 이름 모를 꽃의 봉오리에 발끝이 닿는다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it loses the explicit mutual-death stakes in two lines and weakens several characterization and causal cues.
